name: Rachit
description: Rachit Makwana is a backend software engineer based in Surat, Gujarat, India, specializing in Python microservice architectures, API design, and asynchronous task processing pipelines. As a Google Summer of Code (GSoC 2026) contributor and active maintainer in the FOSSASIA community, he works extensively on the Eventyay platform—optimizing database serialization, building resilient media integration services, and hardening background task queues for production scale. Outside of open-source maintenance, he focuses on backend system performance and automated developer tooling.
